t: Din b' aliyyot zo keneged zo happetuchot lechatzer
s: Din b' aliyyot zo keneged zo happetuchot lechatzer ubo seip echad: shette deyutaot shel aliyyot zo keneged zo happetuchim lechatzer qetanna sheen bah d' ammot al d' ammot, sheen shopekin lah mayim beshabbat ella im ken asu bah guma machazeqet satayim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"z, vehaaliyyot shebbidyuta zo asu guma bechatzer samuk lemirpeset shellahen, vehaddeyuta shekkenegdah lo asu — im erebu b' haddeyutaot im bene hechatzer, kullan muttarim lishpok bechatzer al semak guma sheosta deyuta haachat, lepi shegguma achat matteret apillu leelep diyyurin shebbechatzer mittaam shennitbaer besimman shn"z. Veim erebu leatzman velo erebu im bene hechatzer, shehem asurim lehotzi lechatzer kelim sheshshabetu baaliyyot, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"h — ap al pi ken otah deyuta sheosta guma bechatzer samuk lemirpeset shellah mutteret lishpok memeha bemirpeset shellah, vehammayim yoredim mimmirpeset lagguma hassemuka lah, lepi shello gazeru al kocho bechatzer sheenah meorebet, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"z. Abal otah deyuta shello osta guma samuk lemirpeset shellah asura lishpok apillu bemirpeset shellah, sheyyeredu hammayim mimmennah lechatzer velagguma, shekkevan shehagguma enah semuka lemirpeset shellah, utzerikim hammayim lelek bechatzer ad sheyyaggiu lagguma — yesh lachush shemma yachusu al qilqul hechatzer, veyoliku hammayim beyadam lechatzer velagguma bekelim sheshshabetu baaliyyot. Veken im deyuta hab' lo erebu haaliyyot shebbah beyachad, shehem asurim bemirpeset shellahem bekol kelim sheshshabetu baaliyyot, mippene sheoserim zeh al zeh, vahare zo regel haasura bimqomah veoseret shello bimqoma, dehaynu bechatzer, kemo shennitbaer besimman sha"h, velaken otah deyuta sheosta guma, apillu im ereba im bene hechatzer, enah mutteret lehotzi lechatzer kelim sheshshabetu baaliyyot. Veap al pi ken mutteret lishpok mehaaliyyot al mirpeset shellah vehammayim yoredim lagguma hassemuka lah. Abal deyuta hab' shello ereba leatzmah — yesh omerim sheasura lishpok apillu baaliyyot, mishshum gezera shemma yachusu al qilqul haaliyyot veyishpeku bemirpeset haasura lahem lehotzi lahem mealiyyotehem:
